card.name: Small words in cancer treatment labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation such as with, of, a comma or a section number in oncology label text, mostly about selecting patients or describing advanced cancers. Also fires partway through a few cancer-related names.

modes.label: Linking words in patient selection
modes.description: The words with or of right after phrases like select patients or treatment, before a tumor type or biomarker.
modes.example: Esophageal Cancer • Select patients<< with>> unresectable or advanced or metastatic

modes.label: Numbers and punctuation in lab or section text
modes.description: A comma inside a numeric range or a digit in a section reference.
modes.example: n=114) 12 to 14 g/dL 12.7 g/dL 12.1,<< >>13.3 g/dL Progress

modes.label: Inside cancer-related names
modes.description: A piece of a drug or procedure name such as CYTALUX or hyperthermic.
modes.example: One of these techniques is called hyperther<<mic>> isolated limb perfusion.

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from breast and prostate and toward other terms, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in cancer drug labels, such as the word with in select patients with.
